projects.title: LangChain Sanskrit Chhanda / Metric Poetry
bullets: Personal exploration using LLMs (Gemini, Grok) to generate Sanskrit verses and iteratively improve alignment with a target chhanda (metre).
Implemented automated prompt chaining: when generated text fails the metre validation, detailed checker reports are fed back to the LLM for iterative refinement.
Built a deterministic Python prosody parser for syllable weight (Laghu/Guru) analysis and meter structure checks; deployed interactive demo on Streamlit.

projects.title: SalesVision – ML Forecasting Dashboard
projects.category: MERN Stack, Flask, Regression Models, React Charts
bullets: Built an interactive end-to-end sales forecasting platform with a MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and Flask backend.
Integrated multiple regression-based forecasting models supporting daily, weekly, and monthly forecasting granularities.
Created dynamic visualization dashboards enabling multi-model performance comparison over historical sales data (Winner — GEP Techathon 2023).

projects.title: Sniff CSV – Data Quality Analyzer
projects.category: Python, Flask, React, Data Profiling & Quality
bullets: Built a modular web tool to detect 10+ data-quality anomalies in CSV datasets using rule-based and statistical checks.
Automated the generation of clean Python refactoring scripts and downloadable data health reports.
Provided dynamic summary charts and issue inspection through a Flask + React user interface.

projects.title: Object Detection Model Benchmarking
projects.category: PyTorch, YOLO, Faster R-CNN, Computer Vision
bullets: B.Tech thesis project under Prof. Kalidas at IIT Tirupati, benchmarking object-detection models to explore lighter architectures.
Explored structural modifications focusing on separating classifier and bounding-box regression heads.
Conducted in-depth research reviews on object-detection architectures, feature extraction, and computational efficiency.

projects.title: Jan Dhan Darshak – Utility Locator App

Worked on an anomaly-detection pipeline for clinical datasets using Local Outlier Factor (LOF), Isolation Forest, and COPOD, applying PCA for dimensionality reduction.
Designed and developed an internal issue-tracking system using Power Apps and Azure Databricks, delivering a reported reduction in debugging turnaround time of ~40%.
Developed GxP-compliant data-ingestion pipelines integrating REST APIs with AWS S3 and Amazon DocumentDB.
Integrated Databricks jobs and APIs with Power Automate and user-facing Power Apps workflows.
Resolved 14+ UI and accessibility issues across Angular components, improving usability and accessibility including for visually impaired users.
Worked in an enterprise engineering environment utilizing Angular 8, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, CI/CD, and Linux.
